dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: Ahem, what? I admit that I'm a novice, but every novice has to take their first step, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: I heard cute Fungi live in the rainforest, and there are tiny forest cats and mysterious treasures...

dialogues.speaker: Aberdeen
dialogues.text: The only obstacle between me and my grand adventure is those annoying Forest Rangers. If I can just avoid them, then I can...
